title: Becky Moffat appointed Head of Marketing for HSBC UK - About HSBC | HSBC [UK]
description: HSBC announces the appointment of Becky Moffat as Head of Marketing for HSBC UK effective from the 1st January 2021.

headings.text: Becky Moffat appointed Head of Marketing for HSBC UK

body: Share link to this page on X
Share link to this page on Facebook

Becky Moffat is currently the Global Head of Wealth and Personal Banking Customer Marketing for the HSBC Group. She first joined HSBC in 2016 as Head of Retail Banking Propositions and Current Accounts for the UK bank.

Prior to her time at HSBC, she gained extensive experience across marketing, customer management, proposition design and development of digital marketing from both within financial services, having worked for Barclays, Barclaycard and Santander and from different industries including Media and Retail.

Becky Moffat, newly-appointed Head of Marketing for HSBC UK, said: “I’m incredibly excited by the opportunity to lead this talented and award-winning team and to build on the fantastic work that they have done over the last couple of years.

“As we continue to help our customers navigate the new different we are experiencing in 2020 and beyond, we also have an opportunity to demonstrate the real power and value of our brand – to be helpful to our customers, to foster creativity, deepen customer relationships, and to contribute to and support the communities that we serve.”

Stuart Haire, Head of Wealth and Personal Banking, HSBC UK said: “Becky’s deep understanding of both our customers and our business is invaluable, and I’m very pleased to welcome her to the HSBC UK team. As a bank, our purpose has been to help people navigate change for more than 155 years – and now more than ever, we want to demonstrate to the people, businesses and communities of the UK that we are here to support them and help them thrive.”
Aurora Bonin, HSBC UK | aurora.f.bonin@hsbc.com / 07438 850 833 Email: UKPressOffice@hsbc.co.uk
For the latest news and updates, visit the HSBC UK newsroom: https://www.about.hsbc.co.uk/news-and-media
HSBC UK serves around 14.5 million customers across the UK, supported by 32,000 colleagues.
HSBC UK offers a complete range of retail banking and wealth management to personal and private banking customers, as well as commercial banking for small to medium businesses and large corporates.

HSBC Holdings plc, the parent company of HSBC, is headquartered in London. HSBC serves customers worldwide from offices in 64 countries and territories in its geographical regions: Europe, Asia, North America, Latin America, and Middle East and North Africa. With assets of $2,956bn at 30 September 2020, HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations.
